sloka: ततः शूर्पणखा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।अजामुखा यदुक्तं हि तदेव मम रोचते ।। ५.२२.४०।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt ।ajāmukhā yaduktaṁ hi tadeva mama rocate ।। 5.22.40।।।।

translations.english: "O king of demons, sport with me, my lord. What purpose will be served with this pale wretched Sita, a human being after all?
